options.name: access_policy
options.description: The name of the policy. Only applicable to access ports.

options.name: allowed_vlans
options.description: Comma-delimited list of the VLAN ID's allowed on the port, or 'all' to permit all VLAN's on the port.

options.name: auth_key
options.description: Authentication key provided by the dashboard. Required if environmental variable C(MERAKI_KEY) is not set.

options.name: drop_untagged_traffic
options.description: Trunk port can Drop all Untagged traffic. When true, no VLAN is required. Access ports cannot have dropUntaggedTraffic set to true.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enabled state of port.

options.name: host
options.description: Hostname for Meraki dashboard. Can be used to access regional Meraki environments, such as China.

options.name: internal_error_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if server returns an internal server error.

options.name: net_id
options.description: ID number of a network.

options.name: net_name
options.description: Name of a network.

options.name: number
options.description: ID number of MX port.

options.name: org_id
options.description: ID of organization associated to a network.

options.name: org_name
options.description: Name of organization.

options.name: output_format
options.description: Instructs module whether response keys should be snake case (ex. C(net_id)) or camel case (ex. C(netId)).

options.name: output_level
options.description: Set amount of debug output during module execution.

options.name: port_type
options.description: Type of port.

options.name: rate_limit_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if rate limiter is triggered.

options.name: state
options.description: Modify or query an port.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time to timeout for HTTP requests.

options.name: use_https
options.description: If C(no), it will use HTTP. Otherwise it will use HTTPS. Only useful for internal Meraki developers.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate HTTP certificates.

options.name: vlan
options.description: Native VLAN when the port is in Trunk mode. Access VLAN when the port is in Access mode.
